_note: Settings for Sarvam bulbul:v3. Speakers below are first picks to audition, not final: the Sarvam docs list speaker names without gender, so listen with --audition before generating. bulbul:v3 has no pitch or loudness control; tone comes from the speaker, pace and temperature.

output.format: m4a (AAC, mono, 64 kbps) via ffmpeg; wav kept if ffmpeg is missing
output.loudness: -16 LUFS integrated, true peak -1.5 dB (ffmpeg loudnorm)
